subject: ela
intro: Evaluate arguments and recognize irrelevant evidence.

items.prompt:
Evidence that does not actually support the claim is:
A) irrelevant
B) relevant
C) sufficient

Logical, well-supported reasoning is:
A) sound
B) flawed
C) irrelevant

To 'delineate' an argument means to:
A) identify and outline its claims and evidence
B) ignore it
C) repeat it louder
items.answer: A) identify and outline its claims and evidence

steps: Lay it out. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) identify and outline its claims and evidence

items.prompt:
Read.

'This phone is best: it has a huge screen, long battery life, and the CEO is very tall.'

Which piece is IRRELEVANT?
A) huge screen
B) long battery life
C) the CEO is very tall
items.answer: C) the CEO is very tall

steps: Unrelated to the phone. Key is C.
solution.answer: C) the CEO is very tall

items.prompt:
Read.

'We should protect wetlands: they filter water, prevent floods, and shelter wildlife.'

The reasoning is:
A) sound; the reasons support the claim
B) full of irrelevant evidence
C) unsupported
items.answer: A) sound; the reasons support the claim

solution.answer: A) sound; the reasons support the claim

items.prompt:
Strong evidence for a claim is:
A) relevant and sufficient
B) off-topic
C) a single rare case

Read.

'Our candidate will fix the economy. She jogs every morning and has a lovely garden.'

The argument is WEAK mainly because:
A) the evidence (jogging, gardening) is irrelevant to fixing the economy
B) it uses too much data
C) the claim is irrelevant
items.answer: A) the evidence (jogging, gardening) is irrelevant to fixing the economy

solution.answer: A) the evidence (jogging, gardening) is irrelevant to fixing the economy

items.prompt:
Which argument is STRONGEST?
A) 'The policy works: a study of 40 cities found it cut crime 25%.'
B) 'The policy works because the mayor is popular.'
C) 'The policy works; everyone says so.'
items.answer: A) 'The policy works: a study of 40 cities found it cut crime 25%.'

steps: Relevant, sufficient data. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) 'The policy works: a study of 40 cities found it cut crime 25%.'
